thread:
mara (AE): Heads up — AcmeGov POC requesting GovCloud-hosted trial. Key asks: SDK streaming + function/tool calls + strict structured JSON output. They flagged KMS/HSM + no egress to third parties. Can SEs triage?

 devon (SE): I can take it. Quick q: are they expecting Redwood Hosted GovCloud, Dedicated Reserved in Gov region, or a Private/VPC deploy?

 mara (AE): They prefer Hosted GovCloud (managed) to avoid infra ops, but security says only customer-managed keys + no third-party logs. Also requires websocket support via their proxy.

 devon (SE): Two immediate blockers:
 - Customer-managed KMS: Hosted GovCloud currently supports KMS only via our managed keys; Private supports customer KMS/HSM.
 - Websockets through their proxy: we can fallback to SSE or chunked HTTP streaming but need handshake details.

 ops-bot: Note: "govcloud-hosted" feature flag not enabled for this org. Request ticket or escalate to infra for provisioning.

 sanjay (Solutions): For the POC we can emulate streaming with SSE if websocket is blocked. Small curl demo that streams partial structured tokens:

 ```bash
 curl -N -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY\" \
   -H \"Accept: text/event-stream\" \
   \"https://api.redwood-gov.example/v1/streams?model=rw-gov-1\" 
 | while read -r line; do echo \"EVENT: $line\"; done
 ```

 This will emit chunks like:

 ```text
 data: {"role":"assistant","delta":{"content":"partial token..."}}
 ```

 devon (SE): Also here's a tiny function-call + structured-output example (streaming partial function invocation followed by a final JSON object):

 ```json
 # stream fragments (SSE) -> final message
 data: {"type":"function_call","name":"lookup_account","arguments":{"acct_id":"123"}}
 ...
 data: {"type":"function_result","name":"lookup_account","result":{"status":"ok","balance":4523.10}}
 ```

 jordan @acme-gov (customer): Can you show the part where the SDK does an authenticated webhook call into our VPC? We cannot allow outbound callbacks to third-party endpoints without egress audit.

 devon (SE): For VPC callbacks we recommend Private deployment or a short-lived connector inside their VPC that relays signed webhook events back to the app. Example pattern:
 1) Redwood sends signed event to connector IP (allowlist)
 2) Connector validates signature and forwards locally

 Sample signature header we can support: `X-Redwood-Signature: sha256=...`

 legal: Security questionnaire items:
 - SOC2: we can provide SOC2 Type II report (redacted) — hosted vs private differences noted in comments.
 - KMS/HSM: we need architecture diagram. SEs: can you produce one showing where keys live and what logs are emitted?

 devon (SE): I'll draft a KMS diagram and a short note: hosted-gov = managed keys (no customer HSM), private/vpc = customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM supported) and no external telemetry by default (can opt into logs for debugging).

 mara (AE): Pricing Q from the buyer: 3-month POC, expected 200k tokens/day, ~100 concurrent streaming sessions. Any quick guidance for quoting?

 devon (SE): For a POC like that we usually suggest a small Reserved block + overage rate. Rough estimate for modeling (ballpark): reserved capacity + burst = ~$6k-12k/mo depending on model selection + reserved throughput. Sales should add buffer for streaming egress proxying work.

 mara (AE): Great. Next steps: devon to produce PoC repo/snippets and KMS diagram; legal to start sec questionnaire draft; I will prepare a POC quote (include reserved option + private deployment fallback). Sync tomorrow 11:00 PT. :thumbsup:

 jordan @acme-gov (customer): Thanks — looking forward to the sample repo. Can we get the SSE + function-call example by EOD?
